Overview.Name: T. Ashalatha
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Monday and Thursday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + lightly cooked vegetables
Option 2: Paneer cubes (120 g) pan fried + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & cooked vegetables + curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable fry
Meal_3 (Dinner - lighter): Option 1: Warm curd rice (~150 g) + cucumber salad
Option 2: Vegetable soup + egg bhurji (2 eggs)
Option 3: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + lightly cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid cold foods and refrigerated drinks as they may worsen sinus discomfort.
Keep meals less oily and less spicy to reduce inflammation and body pain.
Start meals with eggs, paneer or curd before eating rice.
Light walking and consistent yoga will help improve neck, back and knee discomfort over time.
For sweet cravings during stress or social gatherings, eat your meal first before taking desserts.
Maintaining regular meal timing and proper hydration will support recovery and energy.
